## How to Credit

Please include this line alongside any reused content:

```
© Emma Belaud, emmabelaud.github.io, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
``` 

## Exceptions and third-party credits {#credits}

This licence does **not** cover:

- Institutional & laboratory logos (CIRAD, INRAE, Eco&Sols, etc.).
- Scientific articles (governed by publisher licences; see [publications](publications.qmd)).
- Third-party content, which retains its original terms. Credits:
    - Root icon: [Racine icônes créées par dDara - Flaticon](https://www.flaticon.com/fr/icones-gratuites/racine){title="racine icônes"}
    
## Commercial Use

If you are a company, or if you want to use this material in a paid product, service, training or publication, please ask for a written agreement before reusing it. If you are not sure whether your use is commercial, ask as well. Write to me through the [contact page](contact.qmd).
